generatedCommentsNodes.comment: The method `isPointGeometry` checks if there is exactly one geometry and if it is an instance of `XYPoint`. However, this check should be done before converting the geometry to Lucene geometries to avoid unnecessary computation. Additionally, the logic in `pointShapeQuery` can be simplified by moving the `isPointGeometry` check earlier.

The line `final XYGeometry[] luceneGeometries = LuceneGeometriesUtils.toXYGeometry(geometry, t -> {});` is duplicated. It should be removed from the second occurrence to avoid redundant code execution.

review_comment: I imagine an edge case where we have a multi-point, but all points are the same, or at least quantize to the same point.
indeed, this requires a bit more work but this is still an improvement.
I see this fix was already in the geo_point case from years ago. So this increases symmetry too.
